sql: SELECT start_station_id FROM trip ORDER BY duration ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(T1.date), T1.zip_code FROM weather AS T1 JOIN station AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.id WHERE T2.city = 'San Francisco' AND T2.dock_count = 0 GROUP BY T1.zip_code HAVING MIN(T1.min_dew_point_f) < (SELECT MIN(min_dew_point_f) FROM weather WHERE T1.zip_code = 94107);
SELECT name, COUNT(*) FROM station GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15;
SELECT date, MAX(T1.max_temperature_f)-MIN(T1.max_temperature_f) AS diff FROM weather AS T1 JOIN trip AS T2 ON T1.date = T2.start_date GROUP BY date ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM weather GROUP BY date ORDER BY MIN(date) ASC;
SELECT T1.name FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flight AS T2 ON T1.aid = T2.aid WHERE T2.flno = 99;
SELECT T1.name, COUNT(*) FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flight AS T2 ON T1.aid = T2.aid GROUP BY T1.name;
SELECT Official_native_language FROM country WHERE Official_native_language ILIKE '%English%';
SELECT Draft_Pick_Number, Draft_Class FROM MATCH_SEASON WHERE POSITION = 'Defender';
SELECT DISTINCT player, COUNT(*) FROM player GROUP BY player;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.College) FROM country AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.Country_id = T2.Team WHERE T2.Name = 'Columbus Crew';
SELECT POSITION FROM MATCH_SEASON GROUP BY POSITION ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom WHERE building <> 'Lamberton';
SELECT MIN(T1.salary) FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_name = T2.dept_name;
SELECT COUNT(*), dept_name FROM student GROUP BY dept_name;
SELECT T1.name, T1.salary FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN advisor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.i_id JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.s_id = T3.id WHERE T3.dept_name = 'Math';
SELECT name FROM instructor EXCEPT SELECT T1.name FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN teaches AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.instructor_id JOIN SECTION AS T3 ON T2.sec_id = T3.sec_id WHERE semester = 'Spring';
SELECT T1.name FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_name = T2.dept_name WHERE T2.dept_name = 'Comp. Sci.' AND T1.salary > 80000;
SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE semester = 'Fall' EXCEPT SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE semester = 'Spring';
SELECT Team FROM Elimination GROUP BY Team HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
SELECT LOCATION FROM wrestler GROUP BY LOCATION HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
SELECT AVG(T2.age), AVG(T2.years_working) FROM journalist AS T1 JOIN news_report AS T2 ON T1.journalist_id = T2.journalist_id GROUP BY T2.role_type;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM student_course_enrolment;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_tests_taken WHERE test_result = 'Fail';
SELECT login_name FROM students WHERE family_name = 'Ward';
SELECT date_of_latest_logon FROM students WHERE family_name = 'Jaskolski' OR family_name = 'Langosh';
SELECT date_of_latest_logon FROM students WHERE family_name = 'Jaskolski' OR family_name = 'Langosh';
SELECT T1.subject_id, T1.subject_name, COUNT(*) FROM COURSES AS T1 JOIN SUBJECTS AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.subject_id GROUP BY T1.subject_id, T1.subject_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC;
SELECT T1.course_name FROM courses AS T1 JOIN student_course_enrolment AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.course_name, T1.course_description FROM courses AS T1 JOIN student_course_enrolment AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.course_id, T1.course_name, T1.course_description HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
SELECT T2.date_test_taken FROM Student_Tests_Taken AS T1 JOIN TESTS AS T2 ON T1.registration_id = T2.registration_id WHERE T1.test_result = 'Fail';
SELECT Headquarters FROM company GROUP BY Headquarters ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT District_name, City_Population FROM district WHERE City_Population BETWEEN 200000 AND 2000000;
SELECT T1.product FROM product AS T1 JOIN store_product AS T2 ON T2.Product_ID = T1.product_id JOIN store AS T3 ON T2.Store_ID = T3.Store_ID WHERE T3.Store_Name = 'Miramichi';
SELECT product FROM product WHERE pages_per_minute_color < 5 INTERSECT SELECT product FROM product WHERE dimensions = 'A4';
SELECT product FROM product EXCEPT SELECT T1.product FROM product AS T1 JOIN store_product AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T2.product_id, T1.product ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Ref_colors;
SELECT product_name, typical_buying_price FROM products;
SELECT T2.color_code, T2.color_description FROM products AS T1 JOIN Ref_colors AS T2 ON T1.color_code = T2.color_code WHERE T1.product_name = 'chervil';
SELECT T2.color_code, T2.color_description FROM products AS T1 JOIN Ref_colors AS T2 ON T1.color_code = T2.color_code WHERE T1.product_name = 'chervil';
SELECT T1.product_id, T2.color_description FROM Product_Characteristics AS T1 JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.product_id, T2.color_description HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products AS t1 JOIN product_characteristics AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id JOIN characteristics AS t3 ON t2.characteristic_id = t3.characteristic_id JOIN Ref_colors AS t4 ON t1.color_code = t4.color_code WHERE t4.color_description = 'white' UNION SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products AS t1 JOIN product_characteristics AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id JOIN characteristics AS t3 ON t2.characteristic_id = t3.characteristic_id WHERE t3.characteristic_name = 'hot';
SELECT unit_of_measure FROM Ref_Product_Categories WHERE product_category_code = 'Herbs';
SELECT town_city, state_province_county FROM addresses;
SELECT T1.payment_method_code FROM Parties AS T1 JOIN Party_Forms AS T2 ON T1.party_id = T2.party_id GROUP BY T1.payment_method_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
SELECT document_type_code, document_name, document_description FROM Documents WHERE document_name = 'Noel CV' OR document_name = 'King Book';
SELECT T1.Project_ID, COUNT(*) FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID WHERE T1.document_type_code = 'BK' GROUP BY T1.project_id;
SELECT budget_type_code, budget_type_description FROM Ref_Budget_Codes;
SELECT budget_type_code, COUNT(*) FROM Documents_with_expenses GROUP BY budget_type_code;
